issues.problem: Context 5 (first to be blamed when sales drop) fits 矢面に立たされる (ky435, same set) just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 数ある部署の中から槍玉に挙げられる so that picking one target out of many is explicit.

issues.problem: reg was 'spoken', but the idiom is just as common in written narration, and the card's own contexts 4 and 6 are written prose.
Context 3 (couldn't accept her evaluation, confronted her boss) fits 食い下がる (ky391, same set) just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it as an immediate angry outburst (聞くなり、声を荒げて), which 食い下がる does not fit.

issues.problem: Contexts 3 (a craze dying out) and 5 (touts gone after a crackdown) fit 影を潜める as well or better: neither shows something once noisy going quiet and possibly coming back.
issues.action: Replaced context 3 with online haters who used to make a fuss going quiet, and context 5 with biker gangs lying low after a crackdown, 'but we can't let our guard down'.

issues.problem: Context 6 and the how line applied it to goods (a craftsman's furniture); it is mainly said of people whom many want to hire or invite.
issues.action: Made the craftsman the subject of context 6 and dropped 'or goods' from the how line.

issues.problem: The lit line 'unable to watch even while watching' was a muddled gloss.
issues.action: Reworded it as 'looking on until one can no longer bear to look'.
